14B. In section 23—
(a) in subsection (1) for “Secretary of State” substitute “Department of
Justice”;
(b) after subsection (8) insert—
“(9) For purposes connected with national security or any matter within
paragraph 9(1)(a) or (b) of Schedule 3 to the Northern Ireland
Act 1998, the Secretary of State may prepare a code of practice
containing any provision that may be included in a code prepared
by the Department of Justice under this section.
